method.filtering_summary: The live search pulled 2,633 postings; 1,860 were older than 7 days, 55 were reposts of listings over 30 days old, 298 were senior or excluded titles, 177 were not target roles, 153 failed Kenya eligibility, 14 were already applied to and 16 were duplicates. A signed-in browser pass of Wellfound failed with a Cloudflare 403 security check (0 pulled). ReliefWeb failed with a parse error. Jobicy's dates look like bump dates, so its listings were rechecked at the source. Fuzu was checked in the signed-in browser (~32 pulled, 2 kept): Britam Fullstack Developer is already in the applied log (12 November); Onfon Media Forensic Investigations Assistant is a different role from the Onfon DevOps and L3 Support applications of 12 November. The MyJobMag personalised feed was also checked in the signed-in browser (~125 pulled, 5 kept): Bridge Talent Junior Software Developer and CGH Technical Officer, Data Analytics are already in the applied log; Tamu Group Associate Programmer Graduate Training Programme, DHA ICT Officer II Software Development, and Onfon Mobile Forensic Investigations Assistant are not. micro1's Software Engineer, Software Engineer - Backend and Software Engineer - Open Source Contributions roles were left off the shortlist because they match earlier micro1 Software Engineer applications under the already-surfaced company-and-title rule. Supabase's Software Engineer - AI Tooling role is open worldwide but asks for 5+ years, so it was dropped. The Arc Python Developer listing returned 404. Most Jobgether leads were Europe-only or used a country list that did not include Kenya. Canonical's Junior Ubuntu Software Engineer role was left off because it was already surfaced in an earlier briefing. The remote shortlist is shorter than the usual 6-10 because few fresh, junior-to-mid roles both stayed open, clearly included Kenya, and had not already been shown.

stories.title: Meituan releases LongCat-2.5 weights, a 1.6-trillion-parameter agent model
stories.summary: The mixture-of-experts model has about 48 billion active parameters per token, a 1-million-token API context and MIT-licensed weights; Meituan is charging a promotional price of about EUR 0.27 per million input tokens and EUR 1.07 per million output tokens.
stories.why: An open-weight, agent-oriented model with OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible APIs is another option for the automation work he builds.

stories.title: Alibaba puts Qwen4-Max on its international Model Studio
stories.summary: The 16 November changelog lists Qwen4-Max as a flagship multimodal model for coding, office work, frontend design and agent tasks, with web search, tool calling, structured outputs and OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible APIs.
stories.why: A new flagship with tool calling and familiar API formats is relevant to the LLM integrations he ships.

stories.title: Apple opens a US study app on how people use clinically grounded health AI
stories.summary: In partnership with OpenEvidence, Apple aims for up to 200,000 US participants aged over 21 on iPhone 15 or later; answers are grounded in sources including NEJM, JAMA and Nature, data is not used to train models, and OpenEvidence deletes query and response data after 24 hours.
stories.why: It shows how a large consumer platform is testing health AI, even though the study itself is limited to the US.

stories.title: Bharat Semi raises $24 million to build AI-enabled image sensors
stories.summary: The all-equity seed round was led by Info Edge Group, South Park Commons and Indus Bridge Ventures; the pre-revenue New Delhi startup has about 75 employees, plans first commercial production in 2027, and has begun hiring engineers in Europe.
stories.why: A well-funded hardware-and-AI startup that is already hiring engineers outside India is a reminder of where specialised AI roles are opening.

stories.title: Australia's central bank: AI effects are showing up first among young software workers
stories.summary: An RBA analysis finds job postings have fallen since ChatGPT launched in late 2022, with the steepest drop in the most AI-exposed occupations, and weaker employment among workers aged 15 to 24 and young graduates in that group; the article also cites an Anthropic review that junior technical hires fell from 27 percent to 9 percent since early 2025.
stories.why: Junior software hiring is under pressure in AI-exposed fields, which is the market he is applying into.

stories.title: Safaricom is pushing M-Pesa beyond payments into a wider financial-services platform
stories.summary: In the six months to 30 September 2026, M-Pesa revenue was KSh100.1 billion (42.8 percent of Safaricom revenue) and financial-services revenue was KSh7.1 billion, up 55.3 percent, with 17.5 million credit customers, 3.4 million money-market-fund customers and 67,500 insurance policies issued, up 852.2 percent.
stories.why: The payments and credit stack he already works around in Kenyan fintech is still expanding.

stories.title: Kenya weighs child social-media rules as Meta expands AI age checks
stories.summary: The proposed Online Safety Bill 2026 would require parental consent and age verification; companies that fail to comply could face fines of up to Sh500 million or 10 percent of annual global turnover, whichever is higher.
stories.why: New platform rules in Kenya can change how consumer-tech and fintech products handle identity and age checks.

stories.title: CBK and CMA tell virtual-asset providers to apply for licences
stories.summary: A joint public notice dated 13 November 2026, reported on 15 November, requires anyone providing or intending to provide virtual-asset services in or from Kenya to apply under the Virtual Asset Service Providers Act, 2025; most categories carry a KSh100,000 application fee, and the regulator must decide within 30 days once due diligence is complete.
stories.why: Licensing for virtual-asset firms is a live compliance issue in the Kenyan fintech market.

stories.title: A Microsoft outage pushed Kenyan banks onto WhatsApp and phone lines
stories.summary: The outage began around 4 PM GMT on Thursday and affected users in 74 countries; in Kenya at least six lenders sent notices, including Equity, Standard Chartered, Stanbic, UBA, I&M, Loop and NCBA's digital bank, while payments and mobile banking were reported as unaffected.
stories.why: It shows how Kenyan financial institutions still depend on a single cloud vendor for everyday operations.
